setupAttempt.classification: Initial temporary-container SSR command used sh; its dash shell rejected pipefail before tsx or any component executed. Changed only the external harness command to Bash; not a product or selector failure.

finding: The native gate-access chip is a descendant of the same ticket-name table cell. Exact text matching of that whole cell does not select the gate-access fixture row. The row containing the exact native Edit button identifies it without relying on chip-free cell text.
limitations: Actual component SSR and Playwright DOM selector behavior only; no staging, authentication, API call, stylesheet, font, capture geometry or visible-layout claim.
Only an external harness and one explicitly named /tmp container script were created. No repository source, original proof helper, proof receipt, screenshot or private journal was changed.
